ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: Arrange 2020 squares with side length 1 as shown in the figure. The points A, $A_{1}$, $A_{2}$, $A_{3}$, \ldots, $A_{2020}$ and points M, $M_{1}$, $M_{2}$, \ldots, $M_{2019}$ are the vertices of the squares. The lines connecting AM$_{1}$, AM$_{2}$, AM$_{3}$, \ldots, AM$_{2019}$ intersect the sides of the squares $A_{1}M$, $A_{2}M_{1}$, $A_{3}M_{2}$, \ldots, $A_{2019}M_{2018}$ at the points $N_{1}$, $N_{2}$, $N_{3}$, \ldots, $N_{2019}$, respectively. The area of the quadrilateral $M_{1}N_{1}A_{1}A_{2}$ is denoted as $S_{1}$, the area of the quadrilateral $M_{2}N_{2}A_{2}A_{3}$ is denoted as $S_{2}$, \ldots, then what is the area of $S_{2019}$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} As shown in the figure, assume the upper left vertex of the leftmost square is denoted as O.\\
$\because$ The 2019 squares, each with a side length of 1, are arranged as illustrated.\\
$\therefore$ OA$\parallel$MA$_{1}$$\parallel$M$_{1}$A$_{2}$$\parallel$M$_{2}$A$_{3}$$\parallel$…$\parallel$M$_{2018}$A$_{2019}$.\\
$\therefore$ $\triangle$M$_{1}$MN$_{1}$$\sim$$\triangle$M$_{1}$OA.\\
$\therefore$ $\frac{MM_{1}}{OM_{1}}=\frac{MN_{1}}{OA}=\frac{1}{2}$.\\
$\therefore$MN$_{1}$=$\frac{1}{2}$,\\
$\therefore$The area of quadrilateral M$_{1}$N$_{1}$A$_{1}$A$_{2}$, S$_{1}$=$1-\frac{1}{2}\times1\times\frac{1}{2}=\frac{3}{4}$;\\
Similarly, it follows that: $ \frac{M_{1}M_{2}}{OM_{2}}=\frac{M_{1}N_{2}}{OA}=\frac{1}{3}$.\\
$\therefore$The area of quadrilateral M$_{2}$N$_{2}$A$_{2}$A$_{3}$, S$_{2}$=$1-\frac{1}{2}\times1\times\frac{1}{3}=\frac{5}{6}$;\\
…\\
$\therefore$The area of quadrilateral MnNnAnAn$_{+1}$, Sn=$1-\frac{1}{2(n+1)}=\frac{2n+1}{2n+2}$.\\
$\therefore$S$_{2019}$=$\boxed{\frac{4039}{4040}}$;

raw_record.original_question: Arrange 2020 squares with side length 1 as shown in the figure. The points A, $A_{1}$, $A_{2}$, $A_{3}$, \ldots, $A_{2020}$ and points M, $M_{1}$, $M_{2}$, \ldots, $M_{2019}$ are the vertices of the squares. The lines connecting AM$_{1}$, AM$_{2}$, AM$_{3}$, \ldots, AM$_{2019}$ intersect the sides of the squares $A_{1}M$, $A_{2}M_{1}$, $A_{3}M_{2}$, \ldots, $A_{2019}M_{2018}$ at the points $N_{1}$, $N_{2}$, $N_{3}$, \ldots, $N_{2019}$, respectively. The area of the quadrilateral $M_{1}N_{1}A_{1}A_{2}$ is denoted as $S_{1}$, the area of the quadrilateral $M_{2}N_{2}A_{2}A_{3}$ is denoted as $S_{2}$, \ldots. What is the area of $S_{2019}$?
raw_record.answer:
\textbf{Solution:} As shown in the figure, assume the upper left vertex of the leftmost square is denoted as O.\\
$\because$ The 2019 squares, each with a side length of 1, are arranged as illustrated.\\
$\therefore$ OA$\parallel$MA$_{1}$$\parallel$M$_{1}$A$_{2}$$\parallel$M$_{2}$A$_{3}$$\parallel$...$\parallel$M$_{2018}$A$_{2019}$.\\
$\therefore$ $\triangle$M$_{1}$MN$_{1}$$\sim$$\triangle$M$_{1}$OA.\\
$\therefore$ $\frac{MM_{1}}{OM_{1}}=\frac{MN_{1}}{OA}=\frac{1}{2}$.\\
$\therefore$MN$_{1}$=$\frac{1}{2}$,\\
$\therefore$The area of quadrilateral M$_{1}$N$_{1}$A$_{1}$A$_{2}$, S$_{1}$=$1-\frac{1}{2}\times1\times\frac{1}{2}=\frac{3}{4}$;\\
Similarly, it follows that: $ \frac{M_{1}M_{2}}{OM_{2}}=\frac{M_{1}N_{2}}{OA}=\frac{1}{3}$.\\
$\therefore$The area of quadrilateral M$_{2}$N$_{2}$A$_{2}$A$_{3}$, S$_{2}$=$1-\frac{1}{2}\times1\times\frac{1}{3}=\frac{5}{6}$;\\
...\\
$\therefore$The area of quadrilateral MnNnAnAn$_{+1}$, Sn=$1-\frac{1}{2(n+1)}=\frac{2n+1}{2n+2}$.\\
$\therefore$S$_{2019}$=$\boxed{\frac{4039}{4040}}$;

Multiple line segments start from A and connect to upper vertices such as M1, M2, M3, M4, etc., and respectively intersect the previous vertical side to form points N1, N2, N3, N4, etc.
Reasoning: According to the specified analytic coordinate method, let A=(0,0), Ai=(i,0), Mi=(i+1,1). We need S2019, corresponding to segment AM2019, where M2019=(2020,1). So the equation of line AM2019 is y=x/2020. Point N2019 is on side A2019M2018, and this side is x=2019, therefore N2019=(2019,2019/2020). Quadrilateral M2019N2019A2019A2020 is located inside the last unit square; it is equal to the square of area 1 minus the upper small right triangle. The horizontal base of this small triangle is 1, the vertical height is 1-2019/2020=1/2020, and the area is (1/2)*1*(1/2020)=1/4040. Therefore S2019=1-1/4040=4039/4040.
